response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT sc.zoneref AS site_code, si.healtheval AS status, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag::text BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY sc.zoneref, si.healtheval), mean_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS m FROM grp) SELECT g.site_code, g.status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - m.m AS beat_by FROM grp g CROSS JOIN mean_avg m WHERE g.avg_ratio > m.m ORDER BY beat_by DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
